storyboard.claim: Mars gravity is far weaker than Earth's, so a drop cannot break the neck.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host points at the red Mars horizon, explaining the weak gravity.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opens the physical explanation of the hanging.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the physical reason the hanging was slow and cruel.

storyboard.claim: The hanged man does not die quickly; he strangles slowly.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, afraid, beside a grave icon for the death he suffers.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the gravity point with what the weak drop means for the body.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the death a slow strangulation, not a snapped neck.

callout.text: the state doesn't provide a heavier drop

storyboard.claim: The state withholds a heavier drop that would have been merciful.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host, worried and thinking, on the Mars horizon of the execution.
storyboard.onScreenText: the state doesn't provide a heavier drop
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the physics to the state's choice.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the state chose the cruel option on purpose.

storyboard.claim: The condemned's family must pull him down out of mercy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo grabs the hanging man's legs while Darrow is drawn struggling.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the state's choice falls on the family.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mercy is performed by the family's own hands.

storyboard.claim: Darrow's uncle had to pull his brother's feet to break his neck.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, sad and thinking, remembers the uncle's act.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the family member who did the pulling.
storyboard.addedInformation: Ties the general practice to Darrow's own family.

storyboard.claim: Forcing a community to execute its own members embeds paralyzing trauma.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host, worried and thinking, on the Mars horizon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: States the lesson of the family's forced role.
storyboard.addedInformation: The trauma is the control: it paralyzes the community.

storyboard.claim: The state gives the Reds a permitted sandbox of culture to keep morale up for work.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host with a sly smirk pointing at the permitted space.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the execution to the state's management of culture.
storyboard.addedInformation: The sandbox is a managed release valve, not freedom.

storyboard.claim: When culture steps outside the box, the state punishes defiance.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The rebel leader, angry, points past the boundary of the box.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the sandbox with what happens when it is left.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rebel leader voices the threat behind the warning.

storyboard.claim: The state makes the family the instrument of death, and Darrow was a child.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, afraid, as a child on the Mars horizon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the cruelty falls on the family, and on the child.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts the child Darrow at the center of the punishment.

storyboard.claim: Darrow's only memory is that his father died without proper dancing shoes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, sad and thinking about the shoes his father lacked.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows what the child fixed on instead of the death.
storyboard.addedInformation: The child's memory is trivial because the horror is too much.

storyboard.claim: The child's mind fractures to avoid the horror.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a blank face, thinking, numb to the horror.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the previous memory as a defense.
storyboard.addedInformation: Blank face reads as numbness, which is the fracture.

storyboard.claim: The township performs the fading durge, beating fists against their chests.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo, sad, with fists held against her chest in mourning.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the family's act to the community's ritual.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the mourning gesture of the ritual in a single figure.

storyboard.claim: The ritual rhythm fades until the fists stop, like a dead heart.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo slumped and sad, as the mourning rhythm dies away.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the ritual to its end.
storyboard.addedInformation: Ends the ritual on the stopped beat, the death of the rhythm.

storyboard.claim: The grief is allowed but terrifies the community into submission.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Chains icon with Darrow, sad, grieving under the permitted mourning.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the ritual is controlled, not free.
storyboard.addedInformation: The chains show the grief is a leash, not relief.

storyboard.claim: Little Eo, Darrow's future wife, is the one who acts after the crowd leaves.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo as a child, worried and thinking, on the Mars horizon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces Eo as the actor of the next act.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the child Eo as the future wife of Darrow.

storyboard.claim: Eo sneaks back to the gallows once the crowd clears.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo, worried, walking back toward the gallows on the horizon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the act that follows the hanging.
storyboard.addedInformation: Her walk back shows she is alone and secret.

storyboard.claim: Eo tucks a blood red hemanthus flower into the dead father's boot.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo, sad, holding the blood red flower.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the object she carries back to the gallows.
storyboard.addedInformation: The flower is held in her hand, the object of the act.

storyboard.claim: The flower is a quiet, invisible act of defiance.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo, thinking, on the horizon after the act.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names what the flower act means.
storyboard.addedInformation: The defiance is invisible to the guards, so the callout carries it.

storyboard.claim: The hemanthus grows in the dark and its roots run deep, so the spirit is not dead.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tree icon for roots, with Eo thinking about the resilient flower.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the symbol of the flower.
storyboard.addedInformation: The tree icon reads as deep roots, the resilience of the spirit.

storyboard.claim: The hosts shift to the view of an operations manager.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host points, neutral, marking the switch in perspective.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the symbolism to the cold business logic.
storyboard.addedInformation: Frames the next beats as the view of the state's managers.

storyboard.claim: Executing the best hell diver for a dance is counterproductive for the economy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host, worried and thinking, weighing the economic loss.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Applies the operations view to the execution.
storyboard.addedInformation: States the economic paradox the hosts want to examine.

storyboard.claim: The whole society depends on the desperate need for helium 3.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host points, neutral, naming the fuel the society is built on.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the economic base of the paradox.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names helium 3 as the basis of the society's need.

storyboard.claim: Viewing the golds as pure profit maximizers makes the killing senseless.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host talking, neutral, on the profit argument.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the reading the hosts reject.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sets up the rebuttal that the golds are not profit maximizers.

storyboard.claim: The golds are engineers of a psychological ecosystem, like managing a controlled burn.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host points, neutral, at the image of a controlled burn.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the better reading: control, not profit.
storyboard.addedInformation: The controlled burn is the analogy for the engineered system.

storyboard.claim: A single spark that jumps the fire line is extinguished with overwhelming force.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host, worried, pointing at the threat of a jumping spark.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the controlled burn analogy to the threat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The spark is the danger that the golds crush at once.

storyboard.claim: The forbidden dance is a spark in the canopy: an idea that belongs to the Reds.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fire icon as the spark, with host pointing at it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Applies the spark to the forbidden dance.
storyboard.addedInformation: The fire is the spark, the idea of the Reds.

storyboard.claim: If one symbol of defiance persists, the narrative of obedience cracks and the dam breaks.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host, worried and thinking, on the consequence of the dam breaking.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: States the consequence of the spark.
storyboard.addedInformation: The dam is the collapse of the obedience story.

storyboard.claim: Terror maintains control, and control over millions is worth more than one hell diver.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Titus, smirking, pointing at the terror he manages.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the Gold logic behind the spark rule.
storyboard.addedInformation: The smirk shows the calculated cruelty of the Gold.

storyboard.claim: The story is the real cage, and the golds will kill to protect it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Chains icon with Titus, angry, pointing at the threat.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the cage the story builds.
storyboard.addedInformation: The angry Gold shows the threat behind the story.

storyboard.claim: A lie that massive is always vulnerable to physical reality.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, worried and thinking, as the lie starts to break.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the Gold logic to the lie Darrow lives in.
storyboard.addedInformation: Points at the moment the narrative will fail for Darrow.

storyboard.claim: Eo is the one who reveals the physical truth to Darrow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo, worried, points as Darrow stands beside her.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces Eo as the one who reveals the lie.
storyboard.addedInformation: The pointing gesture makes Eo the agent of the reveal.

storyboard.claim: Darrow is consumed by the pioneer myth and works himself to the bone.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow slumped and worried, exhausted by the work.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why Darrow needs the reveal.
storyboard.addedInformation: The slump shows the exhaustion of the myth's labor.

storyboard.claim: Words will not break the spell, so Eo must show Darrow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo, worried, points away as Darrow follows her.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why Eo leads him rather than talks.
storyboard.addedInformation: The pointing shows the journey out of the mines.

storyboard.claim: They crawl through crumbling mortar and ancient ventilation tubes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow and Eo walk through the tunnels of the mines, worried.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the route out of the mines.
storyboard.addedInformation: The tubes show the route is old and secret.

storyboard.claim: They crawl upward through absolute darkness, covered in dust, to a heavy grate.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow and Eo, afraid, walking through the dark mine.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the route to the grate.
storyboard.addedInformation: The darkness and fear mark the climb.

storyboard.claim: They exit through the grate into a terraformed dome, a sensory shock.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow and Eo, surprised, in the open dome under the sky.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Reaches the dome after the grate.
storyboard.addedInformation: The sky set shows the open dome for the first time.

storyboard.claim: Darrow's world until now has been rock, sweat, and metal.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, worried and thinking, in the open sky after the mines.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrasts the mine world with the dome.
storyboard.addedInformation: The three words name the mine world he knows.

storyboard.claim: He smells real grass, a strange, sweet, nostalgic smell.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, happy, in the sky set with the grass beneath.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the mine contrast with a new smell.
storyboard.addedInformation: The happy face is the warmth of the new smell.

storyboard.claim: He feels insects buzzing against his skin and cups the floating animals.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, surprised, with insects around him in the sky set.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Adds the sensory detail after the smell.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the sensation of the alien world on his skin.

storyboard.claim: The dome is an alien Eden with bioluminescent floating animals.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, happy, cupping the glowing creatures under the sky.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sums up the dome as a paradise.
storyboard.addedInformation: The happy face marks the wonder of the Eden.
